zh: 蜂蜜蓝莓烤苹果，光想想就甜甜的。
en: Honey berry baked apple... even the thought is sweet.

zh: 鱼和别的岛的好吃的串在一起，就是我最爱的海陆大串！
en: Fish and treats from every island on one skewer! My kind of feast!

zh: 最喜欢那一锅丰收炖菜，能把收获慢慢尝完。
en: My favourite is a harvest pot. A whole harvest to savour slowly.

zh: 黑松露和发光蘑菇，放在一碗汤里很合适。
en: Black truffle and glowing mushrooms. They belong in the same quiet bowl.
